sources.title: GLM-5.3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.title: GLM‑5.3‑Flash on Chinese AI Chips: What It Proves
sources.snippet: Z.ai says GLM‑5.3‑Flash inference ran entirely on Chinese AI chips. We audit the evidence, the SGLang stack, its 3x gain and what is still missing.

sources.title: Ox Alpha = GLM-5.3-Flash served on ~100,000 Chinese chips
sources.snippet: Z.AI reveals Ox Alpha was GLM-5.3-Flash, served 100T tokens/day on ~100,000 Chinese chips — not the Gemini many guessed. Price, benchmarks, what to watch.

sources.title: GLM (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Z.ai released GLM-5.3 on 14 August 2026 and stated that the weights for the model would be made available approximately two weeks after the release date. [8][9] Later that month, Z.ai anonymously previewed a model called Ox Alpha on OpenRouter, which was released with weights on 26 August as GLM-5.3-Flash.
